SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D H 709
Date 3 / 4 / 33

April 3 33.

Dear Fenton,

With reference to our conversation on the
telephone a few days ago about a Mrs. Bryant, who
was alleged to be ill in the General Hospital, a
further telegram was received from Lincolnshires,
Hongkong, requesting that news that a Maxime Maria
Guedes was dangerously ill in the General Hospital
be verified. This was done and the information
was found to be correct. It has since been ascertained
that the person detained in the General Hospital
under the name Maxime Maria Guedes is really Mrs.
Bryant.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕

Captain G.A. Fenton,
British Military Headquarters,
Yu Yuen Camp.

File
〔签名〕
APR. 3 1933

编号 D H 709
日期 33年4月3日

1933年4月3日。

亲爱的芬顿：

关于几天前我们在电话中谈到的据称在广慈医院（General Hospital）患病的布莱恩特夫人（Mrs. Bryant）一事，又收到一封来自香港林肯郡团（Lincolnshires, Hongkong）的电报，要求核实一名名为马克西姆·玛丽亚·格德斯（Maxime Maria Guedes）的人在广慈医院病危的消息。经核实，该信息属实。此后经查实，在广慈医院以马克西姆·玛丽亚·格德斯之名被留院诊治的人实为布莱恩特夫人。

此致
敬礼
〔签名〕

G.A. 芬顿上尉，
英军总部，
俞园营（Yu Yuen Camp）。

存档
〔签名〕
1933年4月3日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.__________
S.I., Special Branch **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date April 3, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Telegram from Lincolnshires, Hongkong.

Made by D. S. Sansom Forwarded by Tho Robertson Supt.

With reference to the receipt of the attached
telegram from the Lincolnshires, Hongkong, asking for
verification of the illness of Maxime Maria Guedes, I have
to report that the person in question is dangerously ill
in the General Hospital and that a reply to that effect
was despatched to the Lincolnshires at 12.45 p.m. on
April 1.

Previously a telegram was received from the same
source requesting information regarding the illness of a
Mr. Bryant. This person could not be traced, and a
reply was despatched accordingly. It is now ascertained
that Maxime Maria Guedes is the wife of Bryant of the
Lincolnshires, and that for some unknown reason she is
registered at the General Hospital under her maiden name
and as a Portuguese subject.

The British Consular Authorities have been informed.

Sansom
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 来自香港林肯郡团的电报。

由 D. S. 桑瑟姆（D. S. Sansom）拟写 由 罗伯逊警司（Tho Robertson Supt.）转呈

鉴于收到附件中来自香港林肯郡团的电报，要求核实马克西姆·玛丽亚·格德斯的病情，兹报告如下：当事人在广慈医院病危，并已于4月1日下午12时45分向林肯郡团发出以此内容为复的电报。

此前曾收到来自同一来源的电报，询问有关一位布莱恩特先生（Mr. Bryant）病情的信息。此人未能查到，遂据此发出回复。现经查实，马克西姆·玛丽亚·格德斯系林肯郡团布莱恩特的妻子，且出于某种未知原因，她在广慈医院以其婚前姓名登记，并作为葡萄牙籍公民登记。

已通知英国领事当局。

桑瑟姆
D. S.
特别分部主管警官。

（左侧批注：登记。请附卷宗。[签名]）

"Bryant, Lincolnshires, Hongkong.

THE GREAT NORTHERN TELEGRAPH COMPANY, LTD.

Senders of telegrams are hereby notified that the
following amendments to the rules regarding international
telegrams will be applied from the 1st April.

Urgent Telegrams.

The rate for international urgent telegrams will be
reduced from three times to twice the rate for ordinary
telegrams.

Deferred Telegrams (IC-Telegrams).

The rule that Deferred Telegrams must be written in
French or in the language of the country of origin or of
the country of destination has been abolished. In future
Deferred Telegrams may be written in any language.

The rule that numbers (whether written in letters or
figures), commercial marks or abbreviated expressions must
not exceed one third of the chargeable number of words in
the text has been altered. In future numbers, commercial
marks or abbreviated expressions must not exceed one third
of the chargeable number of words in the text and signature,
and numbers written in letters are not considered in con-
nection with this rule.

If one third of the text and signature (see above) is a
fractional number, this number is rounded up to the next
integer.

Letter-Telegrams (ILT- and DLT-Telegrams).

The above language rule and one-third figure rule apply
to Letter-Telegrams also.

When applying the one-third figure rule Letter-Telegrams
will always be considered as containing a minimum of 25 words.

Shanghai, 25th March, 1933.

特此通知发报人，关于国际电报规则的下列修订将于4月1日起生效。

加急电报。

国际加急电报的费率将从普通电报费率的三倍降低至两倍。

迟缓电报（IC电报）。

规定迟缓电报必须用法语或原发国或目的国语言书写的规则已废除。今后，迟缓电报可用任何语言书写。

规定数字（无论是用字母还是数字书写）、商业符号或缩写表达不得超过正文计费字数三分之一的规则已修改。今后，数字、商业符号或缩写表达不得超过正文和签名计费字数总和的三分之一，且用字母书写的数字不计入此规则的限制范围。

如果正文和签名（见上文）的三分之一为分数，则该数字向上取整为下一个整数。

书信电报（ILT- 和 DLT-电报）。

上述语言规则和三分之一数字规则也适用于书信电报。

在应用三分之一数字规则时，书信电报将始终被视为至少包含25个字。

上海，1933年3月25日。
